subject: Fix frozen monotonic clock on unsynchronised TSC hosts (#4346)
reason: The change is confined to one-time TSC calibration in monotonicInit_x86linux() at process startup. Its new branches fire only when the host's TSC reads backwards or a calibration sample is degenerate, i.e. on hardware with unsynchronized TSCs. On the fuzzer's hosts (synchronized constant TSC), both builds calibrate identically and select the same clock, so no command, config, fault, tool, or topology can reach the changed code: a compared sequence would mark no real difference and a fault run would never execute the new branches. The fix is untestable in this harness and needs no scenario.
